decisions.reason: The fourth-axis accessory complements the core milling machines at low cost and supports their sales, so with industry turnover growing it meets aspirations and there is no reason for problemistic search.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the core and its results are uncertain, but it fits the firm's strategic push into digital fabrication and materials processing, and the slack from a growing industry allows it to be carried for now.
The high-speed CNC milling line is the heart of the established business and was prominently presented, so it is central to meeting performance aspirations and will be kept.
The automatic tool change system strengthens the productivity value of the core machines and builds on existing competence, so dropping it would not free useful resources.
